model.frozen: one model for the whole season; never refit in-season

sources.observed: PRISM daily (via RCC-ACIS), adjusted to the Daymet scale the model was fitted on
sources.forecast: none (rebuilt after the fact: real weather up to the as-of date, then past years)
sources.after: Daymet 2015-2025, each year's weather run forward
sources.sightings: iNaturalist (CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-NC only; research grade and needs-ID)
